Build a survival response from a clinical data frame

Source: R/survival.R
survival_response.Rd

Build a survival response from a clinical data frame

Usage

survival_response(data, type = c("rfs", "os", "dfs"))

Arguments

data

Data frame such as the included clin_crc dataset.

type

Endpoint prefix: "rfs", "os", or "dfs". The columns <type>.delay and <type>.event must exist.

Value

A survival::Surv() object.

Examples

survival_response(clin_crc, type = "rfs")
